snippet.title: Survivors-like Roguelite Gameplay Trailer | Mini Mart Survivors
snippet.description:
Mini Mart Survivors is a pixel-art survivors-like roguelite where convenience-store stock becomes your arsenal. Watch the official gameplay trailer: evolve weapons, fight monster hordes, and face bosses during a night shift that pays far too well.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4916560/Mini_Mart_Survivors/

Jobs are scarce and the debt won't wait. SHIFT24 offers a way out, if you can make it to the end of your shift. Build your own loadout with ramen, snacks, coffee, and more, then put your pay toward the debt.

This trailer features night-shift combat in Seoul, Texas, Sapporo, Copenhagen, and Hong Kong, plus weapon evolutions, regional bosses, disasters, and the ATM debt-repayment system.

PC / Steam | Single-player | Pixel art | Survivors-like action

#MiniMartSurvivors #Roguelite #IndieGame
